checks.row_formula: 4 controls + 20 sources + 8 measurements + (4 gate prefixes * 48 rules * 20 sources = 3840) + 20 special controls = 3892

accuracy_notes: HSE consultation zones and sensitivity levels were not converted into parcel risk probabilities.
Advise Against and Do Not Advise Against were retained as HSE safety advice, not planning permission outcomes.
Hazardous-substances consent, planning permission and environmental permitting were kept separate.
COMAH lower/upper tiers and public information were not converted into parcel exclusion zones.
MAH pipeline notification duties were not converted into construction or operational safety certificates.
No parcel safety result, consent, planning outcome or Future Growth score was fabricated.
